cells.name: Charge cell
cells.description: A cryo charge cell open to the east (for a west bay): plated walls north, south and west round a frosted chamber, a sealed unit in its charging cradle.

cells.name: Charge cell (open west)
cells.description: The charge cell open to the west, for an east bay.

cells.name: Torn charge cell
cells.description: The charge cell's door torn off at its open east side, its unit frozen half-charged.

cells.name: Torn charge cell (open west)
cells.description: The torn charge cell open to the west, for an east bay.

cells.name: Bore stand
cells.description: A floor-level bore head assembly stand: two rails, cross ties and corner clamps, open in the middle for the head.

cells.name: Great vat
cells.description: A great round culture vat: a bolted rim, its domed lid, a culture port.

cells.name: Burst great vat
cells.description: The great vat split open east, its culture grown out over the floor to the south-east.

cells.name: Print bed
cells.description: A drone print bed: a frame round a gridded build plate, flush to the floor.

cells.name: Core rack row
cells.description: A row of eight server racks east-west, containment door frames at both ends.

cells.name: Launch rack
cells.description: A drone launch rack of four bays, a frame racked in each.

cells.name: Toppled core racks
cells.description: Six server racks fallen over like dominoes.

cells.name: Sorter
cells.description: An automated sorter: its belt east-west, diverters north, outfeed chutes south.

cells.name: Stacker rail
cells.description: Overhead: a stacker crane rail east-west, its carriage parked. Drawn above units.

cells.name: Toppled stacker
cells.description: A stacker crane's mast fallen across a rack row.

cells.name: Fallen reactor column
cells.description: A reactor column fallen on its side east-west, its head torn off at the east end, sludge pooled under it.

cells.name: Pipe rack
cells.description: A pipe rack north-south: three pipes on four supports.

cells.name: Director's booth
cells.description: The holosuite director's booth: its roof, its long window along the east side broken.

cells.name: Fallen print gantry
cells.description: A print gantry's bridge fallen across a bay, its east end sheared.

cells.name: Spoil heap
cells.description: A heap of rock spoil from the bore.

cells.name: Spoil slide
cells.description: A low slide of rock spoil across the floor.
